_README: THE WEEK'S READINGS — nothing here is a score. Scores are computed by tools/build-exec-report.mjs from specs/exec_scorecard_rules.json. Every reading carries a basis: 'actual' (an engine computed it, and the source line says from which upload and to which date), 'manual' (a named person supplied it), 'simulated' (a placeholder so the framework can be reviewed before the feed exists — badged and shaded on the report) or 'absent' (no feed at all: the factor leaves the denominator and the section renormalises). A basis describes the SCORE: a real value measured against a placeholder target is a simulated score.
_actuals: NOTHING IN THIS FILE IS A FIGURE YET. The window is 25 September – 26 October 2026, a CROSS-MONTH range, and the Ops engine's digest (kv:nba-digest) is published for a single calendar month — tools/nba-republish.mjs refuses any other window by design. So this period cannot be filled from the digest: it needs a date-ranged read of the lake (bi_active_cases on contract_create_date, attendance, qa_evaluations, vici_calls, sf_inactive), or an Ops session with its period bar set to this range. `node tools/exec-pull.mjs <dir> --window 2026-09-25..2026-10-26` REFUSES rather than quietly pulling a calendar-month digest and labelling it with this window — which would make every figure on the page a lie about its own period.
